# Place/transition nets on the spine

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`place-transition-nets-on-the-spine` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](place-transition-nets-on-the-spine.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Place/transition nets, defined by their own rules, are an instance of the spine: the flow balances the markings exactly on firing sequences, and dissipation is exactly a strict P-subinvariant on what fires; so rising with falling, bounded taking, rest and the siphon law hold of such nets.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. The net is a law of exchange reading nothing, whose course along a schedule is the net's flow and whose levels along a firing sequence are its markings in units. (`Becoming.Net.law`, `Becoming.Net.flow`, `Becoming.Net.web`, `Becoming.Net.law_nonanticipating`, `Becoming.Net.course_eq`, `Becoming.Net.Fires.levels_eq`, `Becoming.Net.levels_eq_of_enabled`)
2. Balance is the firing rule: along a firing sequence the flow balances the markings in any units, and with every weight positive it balances exactly where the schedule is a firing sequence. (`Becoming.Net.Fires.balances`, `Becoming.Net.balances_iff`, `Becoming.Net.balance_at_iff`)
3. Enabling gives the law's feasibility, so course_balances_iff applies; feasibility is enabling exactly for pure nets fired one transition at a time, and a catalyst and a concurrent step are feasible and do not fire. (`Becoming.Net.Fires.feasible`, `Becoming.Net.Fires.course_balances`, `Becoming.Net.fires_iff_feasible`, `Becoming.Net.catalyst_feasible_not_fires`, `Becoming.Net.relay_feasible_not_fires`)
4. Only active transitions give and take, and only from what they draw on; along a firing sequence activity needs support. (`Becoming.Net.acting`, `Becoming.Net.taking`, `Becoming.Net.Fires.dependent`)
5. With finitely many places listed once, the flow is dissipative exactly where every fired transition loses weighted tokens, which a strict P-subinvariant gives; every step is enclosed. (`Becoming.Net.Loses`, `Becoming.Net.StrictSubinvariant`, `Becoming.Net.Loses.of_lt`, `Becoming.Net.dissipative_iff`, `Becoming.Net.StrictSubinvariant.dissipative`, `Becoming.Net.enclosed`, `Becoming.Net.total_eq_closed`)
6. Along such a firing sequence a place rises only as another falls, the consuming firings number at most the initial weighted tokens and do not recur, and that the marking stops changing cannot be refuted. (`Becoming.Net.rise_with_fall`, `Becoming.Net.rise_with_fall_tokens`, `Becoming.Net.takers_within`, `Becoming.Net.taking_not_recurring`, `Becoming.Net.change_stops_unrefuted`, `Becoming.Net.marking_stops_unrefuted`)
7. Read as a world of places and transitions with finitely many transitions, every premise of World.rests_unrefuted_enclosed holds, so that the world rests from some step on cannot be refuted. (`Becoming.Net.world`, `Becoming.Net.Fires.world_balanced`, `Becoming.Net.world_embodied`, `Becoming.Net.world_counted`, `Becoming.Net.world_dissipative`, `Becoming.Net.world_enclosed`, `Becoming.Net.rests_unrefuted`)
8. The siphon law is the joint-excess law: where every producer of a place consumes at least m from it, joint excess starting below n + m leaves every transition consuming m from it dead; an empty such place stays empty. (`Becoming.Net.Gated`, `Becoming.Net.Gated.gates`, `Becoming.Net.gated_ends`, `Becoming.Net.siphon_empty`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom. The net, its schedule, its starting marking and its weights are given; every other premise is a named property of the net stated where it is used: a firing sequence; finitely many places listed once with equality decided; fired transitions that lose weighted tokens; a gated place; finitely many transitions for the world form.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- That a given chemical, biological or computing system is a given net, with which places, transitions and weights: a modelling correspondence outside the Lean.
- Inhibitor arcs, capacities, timed, stochastic or continuous nets; siphons of more than one place; nets with infinitely many places; deciding reachability.
- That every system in our universe loses at each step; dissipation is a property a net has or lacks, as the conservative cycle shows.
- **Counterexample:** The conservative cycle (Net.cycle): one token moved back and forth between two places fires forever; every premise of the rest law holds but dissipation (cycle_premises, cycle_not_dissipative), its marking changes at every step (cycle_changes) and its world never rests (cycle_never_rests). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/PlaceTransitionNets.lean)
- **Counterexample:** The fed place (Net.fed): refilled by a transition that does not consume it, it is not gated; its flow balances and one step of joint excess starts below 1 + 1, yet a transition requiring it is active two steps later, so the conclusion of Flow.joint_excess_ends fails (fed_fires, fed_refills). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/PlaceTransitionNets.lean)

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. · Stated for discrete steps. · A law of the formal model; its correspondence to actual systems is a separate obligation. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision. · A relation omitted by a weaker description does not refute the fuller account.

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

An outside critique of the opening said the theory proves the rules of its own invented universe and assumes ours runs the same way; the opening proposal's second review ranked an instance theorem for a formalism defined outside the theory as the direct answer. Place/transition nets are such a formalism; the map onto the spine is the identity on what each states.

<a id="dependencies--依赖"></a>
### Dependencies

- **formal-reuse**: [counterfactual-is-the-course](counterfactual-is-the-course.md). Uses ExchangeLaw.course, levels_succ, Feasible and course_balances_iff for the net's law.
  - Output: The course a law of what has stood generates balances exactly where it is feasible.
  - Input: The net's course along a firing sequence balances on the levels it generates.
  - Preserved conditions: The net's law reads what has stood (it reads nothing); the schedule is a firing sequence. [Counterfactual.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Counterfactual.lean)
- **formal-reuse**: [rising-and-falling-in-one-exchange](rising-and-falling-in-one-exchange.md). Instantiates Flow.rise_with_fall on the net's flow and web.
  - Output: In a balanced flow, a member of a family dissipated on that rises has another that falls.
  - Input: A place rising across a step of a firing sequence whose fired transitions lose has another falling.
  - Preserved conditions: Fires (balance); every fired transition loses over the places (dissipated on). [Dissipation.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Dissipation.lean)
- **formal-reuse**: [no-finite-part-bears-taking](no-finite-part-bears-taking.md). Instantiates Flow.Balances.takers_within and Flow.Dissipative.finite_taking_not_recurring.
  - Output: Dissipated on from a step, the takers over a stretch number at most the stock; with finitely many conditions taking does not recur.
  - Input: The consuming firings are bounded by the initial weighted tokens and do not recur.
  - Preserved conditions: Fires; every fired transition loses; finitely many places listed once. [Dissipation.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Dissipation.lean)
- **formal-reuse**: [continued-change-needs-openness](continued-change-needs-openness.md). Instantiates Flow.change_stops_unrefuted_around and World.rests_unrefuted_enclosed.
  - Output: Under balance, dissipation, a census and enclosure, that change stops (the world rests) cannot be refuted.
  - Input: That a net's marking stops changing, and that its world rests, cannot be refuted.
  - Preserved conditions: Fires; fired transitions lose; finitely many places, and for the world finitely many transitions; equality decided. [Openness.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Openness.lean)
- **formal-reuse**: [own-count-misses-joint-excess](own-count-misses-joint-excess.md). Instantiates Flow.joint_excess_ends and Flow.stays_below as the siphon law.
  - Output: Joint excess ends gated renewal and every formation depending on the condition at the gating need.
  - Input: Every transition consuming at least m from a gated place is dead after joint excess; an empty gated place stays empty.
  - Preserved conditions: Fires (balance, acting, dependence); the place is gated at m; unit weights. [Continuation.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Continuation.lean)
- related, not a proved adapter: [premises-read-off-the-exchange](premises-read-off-the-exchange.md). Read off a law of exchange, the tying premises hold and dissipation is a state of the law; for a net's law that state is exactly a strict P-subinvariant on what fires.
